error[ZBX-E0711]: can't make or read the state directory
  cause  neither XDG_DATA_HOME nor HOME names an absolute directory
  fix    set HOME, or point XDG_DATA_HOME at a directory you own
  more   zbx explain E0711 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0711.html
